papers.title: On the Effect of the Cell Size and Beam Radius on the Compressive Strength and Residual Stresses of Ti-6Al-4V BCC Lattice Sandwich Structures Manufactured by L-PBF
papers.abstract: Lattice structures offer the possibility to obtain lightweight components with additional functionalities, improving their shock absorption and thermal exchange properties. Recently, a body-centered cubic (BCC) lattice structure has been used to fabricate metal lattice sandwich panels (MLSPs) for aerospace applications. MLSPs are made of two external skins and a lattice core and can be produced thanks to laser powder bed fusion technology (LPBF), which is characterized by its superior printing accuracy with respect to other additive manufacturing processes for metals. Since few studies can be found in the literature on Ti-6Al-4V MLSPs, further work is needed to evaluate the mechanical response of these panels. Moreover, due to their design complexity and to avoid a costly experimental campaign, numerical simulation could be used to encourage the industrial application of these structures. In this paper, different cell configurations were printed and tested in compression to study the influence of the cell’s geometrical parameters, i.e., the cell size and beam radius, on the mechanical response of MLSPs. Numerical simulations of the LPBF of these geometries were also carried out to understand how the residual stresses can be varied by varying the cell configuration. A geometrical evaluation was carried out to quantitatively express the influence of the beam radius and cell size on the resulting volume fraction, which strongly influences the mechanical behavior and residual stress profiles of MLSPs. From the analysis, we found that the C2-R0.35 sample resulted in the configuration with the highest compressive strength, while C3-R0.25 showed the lowest and most uniform residual stress profile.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ti-6Al-4V BCC点阵夹层结构的压缩性能和残余应力，属于航空航天应用，与骨科植入物股骨柄设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on lattice sandwich structures for aerospace applications, not on femoral stem design or orthopaedic implant structural mechanics; no hip stem geometry or biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 为航空航天应用制造轻量化构件。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验压缩测试和L-PBF过程数值模拟研究不同晶胞构型。
summary_zh.result: C2-R0.35样品抗压强度最高，C3-R0.25残余应力最低且最均匀。
summary_zh.validation: 机械测试与数值模拟验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of cell size and beam radius on the compressive strength and residual stresses of Ti-6Al-4V BCC lattice sandwich structures for aerospace applications.
summary_en.method: Experimental compression tests and numerical simulations of L-PBF process were conducted on different cell configurations.
summary_en.result: The C2-R0.35 configuration exhibited the highest compressive strength, while the C3-R0.25 configuration showed the lowest and most uniform residual stress profile.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and numerical simulation validation.

papers.title: Residual stress-assisted static globularization in electron beam powder bed fusion Ti-6Al-4V from powder recovery and hot isostatic pressing
papers.first_author_affiliation: Applied Chemicals and Materials Division, NIST, 325 Broadway, Boulder, CO 80305, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Nicholas Derimow
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Applied Chemicals and Materials Division, NIST, 325 Broadway, Boulder, CO 80305, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了热等静压和粉末回收对Ti-6Al-4V显微组织球化行为的影响，与AM后处理调控力学性能目标直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: No quantitative fatigue or tensile data reported; focus is on globularization mechanism rather than mechanical property outcomes.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示粉末回收和热等静压过程中残余应力对Ti-6Al-4V静态球化的影响机理。
summary_zh.method: 通过电子束粉末床熔融制备Ti-6Al-4V样品，结合粉末回收与热等静压处理，分析显微组织演变。
summary_zh.result: 残余应力促进了α板条的静态球化，形成了更等轴的微观结构。
summary_zh.validation: 采用扫描电镜和电子背散射衍射表征显微组织变化。

summary_en.motivation: To elucidate the role of residual stress in driving static globularization of Ti-6Al-4V during powder recovery and hot isostatic pressing.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V samples were fabricated by electron beam powder bed fusion and subjected to powder recovery and hot isostatic pressing; microstructural evolution was characterized.
summary_en.result: Residual stress accelerated the static globularization of α laths, leading to a more equiaxed microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural changes were validated using scanning electron microscopy and electron backscatter diffraction.
